The plan says what the analysis does. These pages cover the files that say how people and assistants work on it: `AGENTS.md`, the shared rulebook; `.gitignore`, the list of files Git leaves out; `REPOSITORY-BLUEPRINT.md`, the intended layout; and each person's own instructions for their assistant, which stay outside the repository.
